title: SoupyGuys Packed Modpack
description: Blending technical automation, magical mastery, and overhauled world exploration.
body:
SoupyGuys: A Modernized NeoForge Experience

Welcome to SoupyGuys Packed Modpack, carefully crafted  for Minecraft version 1.21.1 using the NeoForge loader.


 Key Features

Performance: Built with industry-leading optimization mods such as Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore to guarantee smooth frames for any user with modest hardware.

Modern Engineering: Explore a world of automation with Create and Applied Energistics 2.

Exploration: Experience a new world with YUNG's reworked structures (Mineshafts, Dungeons, etc.) and Supplementaries' immersive biomes.

Advanced Magic & Tech: Master the arcane arts with Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks or create high-tech grids with the latest NeoForge-compatible tech mods.

Visual Overhaul: Equipped with Iris Shaders support and Distant Horizons for breathtaking render distances without compromising your PC's health.
